messages.text:
"Create a classic 2D isometric fantasy MMORPG inspired by early 2000s online RPGs.

The game features two opposing nations, Aresden and Elvine, medieval towns, forests, dungeons, monsters, NPCs, and real-time combat.

Include:

- Isometric 2D movement.
- Character creation with Warrior, Wizard and hybrid classes.
- Character stats: Strength, Dexterity, Vitality, Intelligence and Magic.
- Melee weapons, bows, armor and magical equipment.
- Monster hunting, experience, leveling and rare item drops.
- Inventory and equipment windows.
- Magic spells and skill progression.
- Classic medieval MMORPG graphics and atmosphere.
- A playable starting town and monster hunting area.

Start with a fully playable single-player prototype. Build the game with expandable systems so more maps, monsters, equipment, quests and multiplayer features can be added later.

Prioritize authentic old-school MMORPG gameplay over modern graphics. Use original artwork and assets. (3D Game, Desktop)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable single-player prototype of a classic isometric fantasy MMORPG for desktop, with expandable systems.

## Requirements
- Isometric movement; Aresden and Elvine; Warrior, Wizard, and hybrid classes; five character stats.
- Combat, weapons/armor/magic, monsters, XP/leveling/rare drops, inventory/equipment, spells/skills, starting town and hunting area.
- Old-school medieval atmosphere and original artwork/assets; no clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use a browser-based canvas prototype with original procedural pixel-style artwork and UI.
- Assume a single-player game with local save persistence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a game UI shell, responsive styling, and canvas layout.

### Active
- Gameplay implementation is not currently present; previous game logic was overwritten.

### Blocked
- `game.js` currently contains only an empty IIFE placeholder, so the prototype is not playable.

## Next Move
1. Rebuild `game.js` to implement the canvas world, movement, combat, NPCs, quests, inventory, spells, progression, and saves.
2. Connect its controls and game state to the existing interface in `index.html` and `style.css`.
3. Run and verify the prototype in a browser; fix any issues.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and UI element IDs.
- `style.css`: Game layout, styling, and responsive presentation.
- `game.js`: Current placeholder; gameplay implementation must be restored.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no tests or browser verification were completed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable single-player prototype of a classic isometric fantasy MMORPG for desktop, with systems designed for expansion.

## Requirements
- Include Aresden and Elvine, Warrior/Wizard/hybrid classes, five character stats, combat, equipment, magic, monsters, XP/leveling, drops, inventory, quests, town, and hunting area.
- Use original artwork/assets and an old-school medieval atmosphere; assume local single-player saves.

## Decisions
- Use a browser-based canvas prototype with procedural pixel-style artwork and UI.
- Assume offline single-player gameplay with local save persistence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface and responsive styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Began rebuilding `game.js` with game state, class/item definitions, save/load, and HUD updates.

### Active
- Finish `game.js` gameplay and interface wiring; the current file contains only the initial portion of the implementation.
- Run and verify the playable prototype in a browser.

### Blocked
- `game.js` is incomplete and currently ends after `updateHud()` without the remaining gameplay logic or closing IIFE; the prototype is not yet playable.

## Next Move
1. Continue implementing `game.js`: canvas world/rendering, movement, combat, NPC dialogue, quests, inventory/equipment, spells, progression, saves, and controls.
2. Connect all existing interface buttons and modal windows to gameplay.
3. Check JavaScript syntax, run the game, and verify core interactions in a browser.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: In-progress gameplay implementation; currently incomplete.
- `index.html`: Game UI and element IDs.
- `style.css`: Game layout, styling, and responsive presentation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no tests or browser verification have been completed.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable single-player prototype of a classic isometric fantasy MMORPG for desktop, with systems designed for expansion.

## Requirements
- Include Aresden and Elvine, Warrior/Wizard/hybrid classes, five character stats, combat, equipment, magic, monsters, XP/leveling, drops, inventory, quests, town, and hunting area.
- Use original artwork/assets and an old-school medieval atmosphere; assume local single-player saves.

## Decisions
- Use a browser-based canvas prototype with procedural pixel-style artwork and UI.
- Assume offline single-player gameplay with local save persistence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added canvas-based isometric map rendering, basic character/NPC/enemy drawing, movement, combat, enemy drops, XP/leveling, quests, vendors, healing, inventory/equipment, local saves, modal windows, and control wiring in `game.js`.
- Added modal, inventory, map, and toast styling in `game-ui.css`, and linked it from `index.html`.

### Active
- Fix and complete the implementation, then run syntax checks and browser verification for core interactions.

### Blocked
- `game.js` has not been syntax-checked or browser-tested; a global replacement of `closeDialog()` may have corrupted its declaration and changed function calls into non-calls.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and repair `closeDialog` references/declaration in `game.js`; run a JavaScript syntax check.
2. Launch the prototype and verify canvas rendering, movement, NPC interactions, combat, quest progression, inventory/equipment, modals, and saving/loading.
3. Fix any runtime or gameplay defects found and report verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Main gameplay, rendering, UI wiring, state, and save/load implementation.
- `index.html`: Game interface and IDs used by the script.
- `style.css`: Existing layout and game styling.
- `game-ui.css`: Added modal and inventory styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- No tests or browser verification have been completed.
